content.value_statement: Data science projects often lack structured guidance for experiments, feature engineering, model evaluation, and production planning. This skill provides reusable checklists, reference patterns, and starter command-line scaffolds for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Guides production planning across scalability, reliability, observability, security, deployment, and monitoring.
Summarizes general principles for experiment design, feature engineering, and advanced statistical work.
Provides three Python CLI scaffolds that parse paths, record lifecycle timestamps, and report status.
Lists example commands for testing, formatting, training, deployment, and monitoring workflows.
Frames technical leadership responsibilities and example performance targets for production systems.
limitations: The Python scripts are placeholders and do not perform experiments, feature engineering, model evaluation, or data processing.
Several quick-start flags do not match the bundled script interfaces and require correction before use.
The references are high-level and omit formulas, implementation details, and domain-specific experimental guidance.
Performance targets are examples and are not supported by tests, benchmarks, dependencies, or sample data.

use_cases.title: Plan an Experiment
use_cases.description: Structure hypotheses, metrics, validity checks, and analysis steps before an A/B test or observational study.

use_cases.title: Review Production Readiness
use_cases.description: Build a review checklist for model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and reliability before approving production work.

use_cases.title: Assess Platform Requirements
use_cases.description: Assess data pipeline and model serving plans for scalability, observability, privacy, and operational readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Data Science Problem
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this data science problem: [problem]. Identify the target outcome, available data, key assumptions, risks, and the next three analysis steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this to structure an early project discussion.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Experiment Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an experiment plan for [intervention] and [outcome]. Define the hypothesis, unit, treatment, control, metrics, sample considerations, validity risks, and analysis plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this before launching an experiment.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Feature Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a feature engineering plan for [dataset] and [target]. Cover transformations, leakage prevention, missing values, encoding, validation, monitoring, and production consistency.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when preparing features for a predictive model.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a Production ML System
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this production ML proposal: [proposal]. Compare architecture options, evaluation methods, deployment controls, drift monitoring, privacy safeguards, cost tradeoffs, and rollback criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for an advanced architecture or readiness review.

output_examples.input: Create an experiment plan for a new onboarding flow that should improve activation.
output: Hypothesis: the new flow increases seven-day activation without increasing support contacts.
Randomization unit: account, with treatment assigned before onboarding begins.
Primary metric: seven-day activation rate; guardrails include completion time and support contact rate.
Validity checks: sample-ratio mismatch, missing outcomes, cross-device contamination, and novelty effects.

output_examples.input: Review a churn model for production readiness.
output: Evaluation: compare against a simple baseline and report time-based validation by customer segment.
Data controls: document label timing, leakage checks, missing-value behavior, and feature freshness.
Operations: define latency, drift alerts, fallback behavior, rollback criteria, and retraining ownership.
Governance: review privacy, access controls, decision impact, and human escalation requirements.

best_practices: Verify every command and flag against the bundled script before execution.
Treat performance targets as planning examples until measured in your environment.
Provide domain context, data constraints, and decision criteria in each request.
anti_patterns: Do not assume the bundled scripts perform real statistical or machine learning work.
Do not run deployment commands against a live environment without review and explicit authorization.
Do not use generic reference guidance as a substitute for legal, privacy, or domain expert review.

faq.question: Does this skill execute real data science analyses?
faq.answer: No. The bundled Python scripts validate minimal arguments and return status metadata, but their core processing methods are placeholders.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What guidance does the skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides general checklists for production planning, experiments, features, model operations, monitoring, security, and technical leadership.

faq.question: Is the included code production ready?
faq.answer: No. It lacks domain logic, dependency declarations, tests, benchmarks, input processing, and output persistence.

faq.question: Does the skill include data or trained models?
faq.answer: No data or models are included. You must provide appropriate inputs and validate access, privacy, and quality requirements.

faq.question: Can I customize the prompt templates?
faq.answer: Yes. Replace placeholders and add business context, constraints, metrics, data details, and decision criteria.
